description: Deterministic Renee Defense Down bucket discriminator. minxxx attacks with Renee and Hendrik, fielding 120 T6 lancers into WIP's 446 T9 infantry. Hendrik's only unlocked expedition skill is persistent 5% Defense Down. Using estimated current stats reconstructed from recent reports, homogeneous Renee Defense Down predicts WIP wins with about 34 infantry; homogeneous Health Down or Damage Taken Up predicts minxxx wins with about 5 lancers. The candidate configurations and comparison rule are frozen before capture; exact captured stats will be inserted into those unchanged candidates after the report.
